workflow_name: eHRP Align Closed-Loop Onboarding Governance Pipeline

stages.name: Multi-Source Document Ingestion & Volatile Rendering
actions: Accept PDF, image, or text onboarding package in volatile RAM
Detect low-text or noisy scanned PDFs automatically
Render up to 12 pages into Base64 JPEG streams (100 DPI, quality 85) without disk write

stages.name: Multimodal Extraction with Source Grounding Hierarchy

ground_truth_rules.salary_rank_grade_point: Employment Contract Clause 3 & Interview Evaluation Form
ground_truth_rules.bank_and_account: Bank Card Copy / Direct Deposit Authorization
ground_truth_rules.emergency_contact_and_history: Job Application Form (Demo-Form-001), CV & Certificate Scans

guardrails: ZERO_HALLUCINATION: Return empty string '' for illegible or missing attributes
NO_AUTONOMOUS_PROFILING: Strictly administrative schema extraction only

stages.name: Deterministic Schema Alignment & Code Mapping
transformations: Format currency fields to 2 decimal places (0.00)
Split secondary Chinese full name into surname_secondary and given_name_secondary
Map department labels to enterprise codes (HQ, ENG, OPS, HR, FIN, IT, LEGAL)
Correct OCR typos in bank names against standard dictionary (HSBC, HANG SENG, BOC, etc.)

stages.name: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Verification Gate
actions: Inspect normalized fields across 8 structured UI tabs
Cross-check extracted values against original physical/scanned documents

stages.name: Clean Payload Export, Auto-Fill & Memory Destruction
actions: Inject payload into target eHRP web DOM fields via Chrome Extension Manifest V3
Release session memory immediately upon page reload or tab closure
